snippet.title: Fourmiworld - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3747140/Fourmiworld/
ALSO ON ITCH.IO: https://zapathie.itch.io/fourmiworld
Carve your own path through Fourmiworld - an "open-world-ant-farm-metroidvania". Play as an interdimensional urban explorer girl, collect gamut to unlock new abilities, and discover the sights, plights, & soundbites of a surreal alien dimension.

https://cheyennix.carrd.co/

You can also join our Discord server if you want! We don't bite!
https://discord.com/invite/XNwpTQEqca
